style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;align=left;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="65" width="1399.032" height="65" /></mxCell><mxCell id="notes" value="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ}<br>are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. {xor}: each chunk has either a section parent or a<br>document parent; both links require the same indexAttemptId.<br>Chunk has one parent selected by strategy: section OR document. The two optional parent links are alternatives, not simultaneous parents. Semantic tables use rowId PK and<br>UNIQUE(id,indexAttemptId). Historical candidates can exist; retrieval serves accepted active rows. Migrations declare partial uniqueness for active rows: at most one active ReelDocument<br>per Reel, and one active section/chunk/scene per stable id. Live migration application is not probed.<br>reel: reelId: cross-service reference (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document: parentId = reelDocumentId, same attempt (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document:<br>parentId = reelDocumentId, same attempt (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); section parent: long-form chunk: parentId = sectionId (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document<br>parent: short/document chunk: parentId = reelDocumentId (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)" vertex="1" parent="1" style="shape=note;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;fillColor=#fff8ed;strokeColor=#687782;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="1474.9840000000002" width="1399.032" height="208" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ}
are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. {xor}: each chunk has either a section parent or a
document parent; both links require the same indexAttemptId.
Chunk has one parent selected by strategy: section OR document. The two optional parent links are alternatives, not simultaneous parents. Semantic tables use rowId PK and
UNIQUE(id,indexAttemptId). Historical candidates can exist; retrieval serves accepted active rows. Migrations declare partial uniqueness for active rows: at most one active ReelDocument
per Reel, and one active section/chunk/scene per stable id. Live migration application is not probed.
reel: reelId: cross-service reference (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document: parentId = reelDocumentId, same attempt (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document:
parentId = reelDocumentId, same attempt (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); section parent: long-form chunk: parentId = sectionId (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document
parent: short/document chunk: parentId = reelDocumentId (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)
